question: Which divine figures preside at Gaṅgāhrada and at Bhittipurī?
premises: Gaṅgāhrade names the first sacred site.
Trilokeśo is the presiding figure there.
Bhittipuryāṃ names the second sacred site.
Divākaraḥ is the presiding figure there.
inference: The lord of the three worlds presides at Gaṅgāhrada and the sun presides at Bhittipurī.
plain_english: At Gaṅgāhrada is the lord of the three worlds, and at Bhittipurī is the sun.
